description.en:
One night, a criminal is hunted down for the attempted murder of a general,
Lin Ran, a prefectural lieutenant, tells the criminal to surrender quietly.
However, the guilty party is a former schoolmate of Hao Chen...

The new issue of “J.GARDEN52” by the circle “SERVICE BOY” is a new work by Hong Tteok,
The new issue of “J.GARDEN52”, a new [original] BL book by Mr. Hong Tok, is “Houou no Fu”!

In their school days, they were always together,
When they were students, they were always together and even professed that they were not interested in anyone except for Hao Chen.
But then Hao Chen suddenly disappeared, and at the time I thought there must be a reason.
At the time, I thought there must be a reason and waited for his return,
However, Lin Ran gradually came to believe that Hao Chen had hated him.

But after he left, Lin Ran began to think that he was hated by Hao Chen,
Hao Chen, who realized how much he had been protected by Lin Ran after Lin Ran was gone, decided that it was his turn to help Lin Ran,
Now he thinks that it is his turn to save Lin Ran....

Hao Chen, a former schoolmate of Hao Chen, and Lin Ran, a criminal, are reunited after an incident,
They meet again after a certain incident,
This is a fantasy BL work in which two former schoolmates, Hao Chen and Lin Ran, recall their past and seek each other out.
Please enjoy this fantasy BL work.
